==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am trapped inside of an elevator. While trying to escape, something cuts my ear. I then see a flash of a stuffed animal with yellow cotton sticking out of the top of it's head.

Following my spontaneous vision, I feel different. I try to escape the elevator again. This time I seemingly phase right through it.

I see a bunch of nails floating in a courtyard. The nails merge together and form a series of spaceships. I hop into one and try to pilot it to fend off the others, but shortly afterwards I wake up.
